title: SDSC Summer Institute 2026: HPC & Data Science
description: This repository hosts all teaching material, slides, and tutorials for the SDSC Summer Institute 2026 on High-Performance Computing and Data Science. The institute ran from July 23 to August 7, 2026, covering topics including HPC fundamentals, running batch and interactive jobs, high-throughput computing, data management, Python for HPC, and parallel computing concepts.
